description:
Land Acquisition - Kalapaluwawa Cemetery in Kalapaluwawa, Kaduwela Municipal Council, Colombo District, 
Land Acquisition - Batapotha Cemetery Batapotha, Kaduwela Municipal Council, Colombo District
categorisation: This gazette notification primarily deals with land matters, specifically the designation of two parcels of land (Kalapaluwawa Cemetery and Batapotha Cemetery) as public cemeteries. The content includes detailed land descriptions, boundaries, survey information, and property ownership details, which are characteristic of Land Gazettes (Type 4). While it mentions government officials (the Governor) and references legal ordinances, the core subject matter is land use and property designation for cemetery purposes.
